      "claim": "The model exploits trial-specific signatures (e.g., task direction) that transfer to new trials within the same subject/session.",
      "mechanism": "Task-level information shared across windows of a single trial allows generalization from training windows to test windows on unseen trials, driving high window split performance but low trial split performance.",
      "supporting_evidence_ids": ["obs_1"],
      "limitations": "Does not account for subject-specific identity effects or domain shifts."
    },
    {
      "id": "H2",
      "claim": "The model exploits subject/session identities (identity/collection effects) rather than trial content.",
      "mechanism": "Labels are correlated with unseen metadata features of the test subjects/sessions, causing high performance when those entities overlap between train and test sets but failing on truly disjoint ones.",
      "supporting_evidence_ids": ["obs_1"],
      "limitations": "Cannot distinguish from trial-specific effects without permutation tests."
    }
  ],
